source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) ends, pick an enemy unit Eldrad Ulthran can see within 18″. Friendly **AELDARI** models get +1 to **[Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)** for attacks against that selection. The bonus expires when your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

recipient.trigger: each attack against selected enemy unit
